==========

Here's a continuation of the previous chapter, which explores the exciting new plays Xiayao and Zhaohong engages in after her complete corruption. This time, we get a glimpse of the sister, Xiaxiong, and her secretary. It seems that they might be subjects of Zhaohong's hypnosis too, but we'll only know in the next chapter! I can't wait to translate that too!

Following this update, I'm intending on releasing new chapters weekly instead of fortnightly now so that I have time to work on my other projects. If you'd like to see anything be translated, feel free to contact me and we can work something out!

Once again, happy masturbating!

-Zen

==========

My usual disclaimer:

This translation is largely assisted with machine translation but still proofread and edited by me. As such, I have taken a few creative liberties to make the text read smoother to native English readers. For example, "阿飞" is translated to "Fei" instead of literally "Ah Fei". The use of "Ah (阿)" in this context is similar to how people would use "-chan (ちゃん)" to address people. However, unlike Japanese, the transliteration of "Ah" is confusing when used with sound effects that only "Ah~" provides the best nuance.

Several sentences were also shortened because of the complex sentence structure Mandarin has to describe simple things. They won't be elaborated here, but I thought you should know if you've read both the Mandarin and English-translated versions.
